narrative.details:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
narrative.objectives: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolaanar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
narrative.offerRewardText: The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
